release_notes: The Dahua IPC-HDW3841TP-ZAS is an 8MP 4K Starlight WizSense turret with a 2.7-13.5mm motorized varifocal lens, 50m IR, built-in mic and SMD Plus. 2026-07-22: verified against the official Dahua datasheet for IPC-HDW3841T-ZAS, whose Ordering Information table lists IPC-HDW3841TP-ZAS (PAL) as a regional order code of the base model (IPC-HDW3841TN-ZAS is the NTSC variant). This confirms it is a genuine distinct Dahua SKU, not a relabelling of the neighbour IPC-HDW3841T-ZS-S2. Replaced the incorrect axilogi reseller-mirror source (which was actually the IPC-HDW3841T-ZS-S2 datasheet) with the official material.dahuasecurity.com datasheet, and corrected two fields a prior audit had wrongly changed: IR range back to 50 m and SMD back to SMD Plus, per the official datasheet.

frigate.notes: Dahua native RTSP path; enable RTSP in the web UI (default admin).
